title: Body of army captain flown to New York | The Star
text:
Body of army captain flown to New York | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The body of army captain Hasman Hussin (pic) , who died in the floods in Missouri, was flown to New York Saturday.
The Army Headquarters in a statement said efforts to bring home the remains of the captain was underway after the completion of paperwork and other formalities at the morgue in Waynesville, Fort Leonard Wood at 11am Friday morning.
